headline: House advances disability work bill while Iran war powers measure clears—Senate prepares for pivotal cloture fight on intel director Monday.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed the Lunar Landing Day Act (S. 5123) designating July 20 as a federal holiday, and approved a resolution naming July 25 National Day of the American Cowboy. On nominations, senators confirmed Daniel Mack Traynor to the Eighth Circuit Court and Antonio M. Pozos to the Eastern District of Pennsylvania. The chamber saw two key votes fail: a 47-49 motion to discharge a committee on Iran war powers (S.J. Res. 180) and a cloture attempt on the Seed Act was entered, with the actual vote postponed pending the Clayton Director of National Intelligence nomination.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House passed H.R. 8884, the Removing Barriers to Work for Disabled Americans Act, 232-188, which reauthorizes the disability insurance program's demonstration authority. The chamber also approved H. Con. Res. 89 by a vote of 214-208, directing the President to remove Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran under the War Powers Resolution. The Speaker designated July 23 through August 30 as a district work period.
